purpose: One entry per property an engine can answer: the measured error of that property, the source it was measured against, and whether the number the answer declares actually covers it. screen() may rank candidates only on CALIBRATED properties.
method: Measured error is recomputed from stored per-point rows, or (for the locked solubility set) from the 2399-row prediction CSV, by tools/calibration_check.py. A declared error bar is compared with the measured metric of the same kind. Verdicts are assigned by rule, not by hand.

verdicts.CALIBRATED: measured error exists and the declared bar covers it (bar = typical error, not a bound)
verdicts.MEASURED_NOT_DECLARED: a measured error exists but the answer does not declare a comparable bar (numerical bracket, research-only engine, or an explicit 'no bar')
verdicts.UNCALIBRATED: no independent measurement in this repository; the model may be used only as a range or a refusal-backed hint, never for ranking
verdicts.REFERENCE_ONLY: value comes from a compilation, not a model with a measured error; ranking heuristics only
verdicts.DEFINITION: exact by definition of the quantity, no model error

dataset.name: AqSolDB locked split, single evaluation
dataset.source: AqSolDB, DOI 10.7910/DVN/OVHAW8, CC0-1.0; split and preregistration in validation/solubility/plan.md; evaluated once 2026-10-25

declared.scope: in-domain only (neutral, single component, no metal, MW <= 500, no phosphorus)

measured.scope: in-domain rows of the locked set, P-A (published) coefficients
measured.note: the 1.2 bar is the in-domain RMSE rounded down by 0.02; out-of-domain bar 5.0 covers the measured 4.0989

limits: neutral single-component organics in water at 25 C only
bar is a typical error (RMSE), not a worst case: 36 % of in-domain molecules are off by more than 1.0 log unit
whole-set RMSE is 2.14 and out-of-domain RMSE is 4.10; never quote 1.2 outside the in-domain group

dataset.name: Straver & de Loos 2005, nine solutes in water
dataset.source: Straver & de Loos (2005) J. Chem. Eng. Data 50, 1171-1176, DOI 10.1021/je0495942; values via the NIST/TRC ThermoML record; replicates averaged in tools/gamma_validation.py
dataset.license: published literature (citation); raw data not redistributed here

declared.where: mcp/engines.py UNIFAC_RELATIVE_BAR; answer error kind 'model', lower 0.7x upper 1.3x

measured.note: bar is the typical (median) error; the tail reaches 46 % (diacetyl, a known UNIFAC gap) and 30.4 % (2-butanone)

limits: infinite-dilution limit only: nothing here validates a full composition range, an azeotrope, a liquid-liquid split or a wax/solvent mixture
water as solvent, one temperature (298 K), one data source (one paper)
diacetyl-like adjacent carbonyls are a known model gap (about -46 %)

entries.property: gamma-infinity in water at 298 K, COSMO-SAC route

engine.name: cCOSMO-SAC (NIST COSMOSAC-2010) with PubChemQC sigma profiles and stored refit constants

dataset.name: Straver & de Loos 2005, nine solutes in water
dataset.source: Straver & de Loos (2005) J. Chem. Eng. Data 50, 1171-1176, DOI 10.1021/je0495942; sigma profiles from PubChemQC
dataset.license: published literature (citation); synthetic sigma profiles are a re-parameterisation

declared.where: not exposed as an answer: no adapter, no MCP tool, no error bar

limits: research only: not reachable from an answer, so it cannot mislead a user - keep it that way until a bar exists
sigma profiles are a refit, so the comparison is 'our pipeline', not 'COSMO-SAC in general'

engine.name: pycalphad equilibrium + bisection over MatCalc open databases

dataset.name: Published melting points and Al-Cu liquidus, seven points
dataset.source: docs/ALLOY_VALIDATION.md, transcribed from the Al-Cu phase diagram; databases MatCalc open (ODbL-1.0 + DbCL-1.0) kept outside the repo in KJ_TDB_DIR
dataset.license: ODbL-1.0 + DbCL-1.0 (databases, external); published values cited

declared.where: mcp/engines.py error kind 'bisection bracket', lower/upper = value -/+ bracket/2; the answer limits say it is numerical resolution, NOT database or model uncertainty
declared.scope: numerical only; widest half-width observed 0.342 K, typical 0.10-0.20 K

measured.note: pure elements 0.01-0.24 K; Al-Cu liquidus 1.6-8.3 K, worst at 17.3 at% next to the eutectic

limits: the answer declares only the bisection bracket (0.02-0.34 K); the database error is up to 8.3 K and is NOT in the answer
published Al-Cu values are read off a printed diagram (about +-2 K), so the 8.3 K point is partly read-off error
melting and liquidus only: no creep, oxidation, corrosion or mechanical strength

engine.name: ideal solid-liquid equilibrium, activity coefficients = 1
engine.version: tools/wax_melting.py; Tm and Hfus from chemicals 1.5.2

dataset.name: none
dataset.source: no independent wax mixture data in this repository

declared.where: mcp/engines.py error kind 'range', lower = last solid, upper = wax appearance; this is the physical melting range, not a model uncertainty

measured.note: unvalidated by construction: gamma = 1 ignores every interaction in the mixture

limits: range only, never a single melting point
no activity coefficients, no rheology, no wax content, no pour point, no performance claim
cannot be used to rank candidates against each other

dataset.name: IUPAC average atomic weights
dataset.source: definitional: sum of average atomic weights of the structure as drawn

declared.where: mcp/engines.py error kind 'definition', lower = upper = value

measured.note: no measurement needed; exact given the structure and the atomic weight table

limits: average mass, not monoisotopic and not measured mass
implicit hydrogens included; the structure as drawn is the only input

dataset.name: none
dataset.source: no measured logP set in this repository

declared.where: mcp/engines.py returns no error bar for logP (only for molecular weight)

measured.note: Crippen logP is an atom-contribution model; its literature error is about 0.5 log units but this repo has not measured it

limits: no error bar is declared: do not rank on logP and do not present it as a measured partition coefficient
logD at a pH, permeability and formulation behaviour are out of scope

entries.property: Hansen solubility parameters (dD, dP, dH) and distance Ra

dataset.name: Hansen parameter compilation
dataset.source: values carried by the chemicals package; per-value provenance and measurement conditions are not recorded

declared.where: gate.hsp returns 'ranking only'; no error bar is attached to Ra

measured.note: no measured compatibility or solubility set in this repository

limits: ranking heuristic only: a small Ra does not prove miscibility, and Ra ignores temperature and concentration
substances with no Hansen entry (petrolatum, waxes, polymers) must stay RED
